rules.disease: Type II Atypical Adult Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris
rules.sentence: Clinical findings of type II PRP may be similar to those in classical PRP but with more eczematous plaques, ichthyosiform scale, especially on the lower extremities, coarse laminated palmoplantar keratoderma, and more pronounced alopecia.

rules.disease: Type II Atypical Adult Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris
rules.sentence: Care must be taken when making this diagnosis since, clinically, it has a substantial overlap with erythrodermic mycosis fungoides, Sezary syndrome, and paraneoplastic phenomena.[34]
